problem: A B2B SaaS growth marketer cannot give the web team defensible evidence about where the site's machine-readable path differs from a competitor; this skill compares live browser-control and simulated crawler User-Agent responses, then returns a one-page field report with matched evidence, correct ownership, review-only actions, and explicit recheck conditions.

skills.role: Compare a site and competitor through browser-control and crawler User-Agent requests, then produce a proof-backed remediation handoff
